jobs.title: Consultant Network Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title requiring established experience managing partners/consultants, plus lead generation, business development and account management — a relationship/sales-channel role that is neither entry-level nor a match for the candidate's research profile. It sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones and requires skills they do not have.

jobs.title: IATF Assessor
jobs.reason: Requires IATF 16949 automotive auditor qualifications, substantial third-party auditing experience, and fluency in Japanese as essentials — none of which the candidate holds. It is also a senior/lead-level assessor role in automotive quality management, entirely outside the candidate's field.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: Fresh graduates are welcomed as trainees, so despite the "Lead" title this is not gated by experience, and the essential technical requirements (degree in Law/Engineering/Textile preferred, English, Excel) are soft enough that the candidate is technically eligible. However, social-compliance ESG auditing in Taiwan is far outside all three interest zones and a poor paper fit for an IR/international-law researcher — the field, technical audit focus, and extensive-travel field-audit nature make this a weak match on nearly every axis.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory-committee members, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established experts to advise on the project, which the candidate is not, and it reads as a voluntary/speculative committee position rather than a genuine salaried vacancy. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but the level and nature of the posting are disqualifying.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert Advisory Committee members — it seeks established experts and activists with a track record in climate justice / defender protection, not an entry-level paid role the candidate could take. It reads as a voluntary/advisory appointment with no salary and requires seniority the candidate lacks, so it fails the genuine-paid-entry-level gate.

jobs.title: Academic Head of Division_ Dermatology (AC.06.3)
jobs.reason: Requires a medical qualification registerable with the HPCSA as a specialist dermatologist plus at least 5 years' sub-specialist experience and mid-management leadership — none of which the candidate holds. It is also a senior Head-of-Division role far above entry-level and entirely outside the candidate's field.

jobs.title: Academic Head of Division_ Pulmonology (AC.06.3)
jobs.reason: Requires a medical qualification registerable with the HPCSA as a Pulmonology sub-specialist plus 5+ years' sub-specialist and mid-management experience — none of which the candidate holds. It is also a senior Head-of-Division role, wholly outside the candidate's field and level.

jobs.title: Academic Head of Division_ Haematology (AC.06.3)
jobs.reason: Requires a medical qualification registerable with the HPCSA as a specialist in Haematology plus 5+ years as a sub-specialist and mid-management experience — none of which the candidate holds. This is a senior academic-clinical headship completely outside the candidate's field and level.
